title: ADR: record-scoped AI inquiry — context pack type, `get_record_context`, conversation focus, `ask_ai`, skill `context`, citation shape
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Source: topic #36996.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (blocks the epic's children from being dispatched) · reach: n/a · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：把「记录资料包」怎么声明、怎么读、怎么交给模型，以及「问 AI」按钮、对话焦点、技能指定资料包、答复引用的格式写成一份决定记录。
- 需要你做的：手工合并这份 ADR；后面的子卡等它。

## What
One ADR in `docs/adr/`, with a `## Provenance` section naming the cloud record (objectstack-ai/cloud#4960) and its date. It decides:
1. Admission of the `ai_context` metadata type under ADR-0088 (own lifecycle, declarable governance, a real consumer), and its v1 keys. Only keys with an enforcer in the first implementation PR are listed (ADR-0049); a body fallback to knowledge search is named as later work.
2. Why the recipe is not on the object: `packages/spec/src/data/ai-read-exposure.ts` keeps the object-level `ai` key refused on business objects, and this ADR does not reopen that ruling.
3. The render contract: read as the caller; labelled fields with option labels; "not visible to you" for a field hidden by field-level rules; an unreadable related row is absent; a long body becomes an outline; output wrapped as data, not instructions (one shared wrapper).
4. `get_record_context`: one definition in spec, one executor, every transport (ADR-0149 D2); under `data:read`; the system-object and API-exposure refusals of the record tools apply.
5. Which package owns the render service (a name here is a proposal; the tree's precedent decides, AGENTS.md).
6. `ToolExecutionContext.focus` (client-reported, advisory, one record in phase 1) beside `surfaceContext`.
7. The `ask_ai` action type: an action that dispatches to the assistant, never materialised as an action tool, absent where the edition has no in-app assistant.
8. The skill key `context` (names a context pack) and its readers (MCP skill prompts in this repository; the in-app runtime in cloud).
9. The citation shape an answer may carry (`object`, `id`, optional anchor, quote). Shape only; rendering is a later card.
10. Not decided here: field egress.

## Acceptance
- PR open, Status Proposed; anchors under `scripts/adr-anchors/` are left to the implementing cards. Governed surface: the maintainer merges by hand.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#4960
Parent: #36996. Reader: the seat that takes spec ADR text.
Dedupe: `is:open metadata type admission ADR-0088` 3 (#36868: precedent, no overlap) · `ai_context` 0.
